title: 4DCodeBench: Benchmarking Agents on Inverse Graphics of Dynamic Scenes
why_read: A new benchmark testing whether AI agents can reconstruct dynamic physical scenes as executable code, exposing a real gap between static and dynamic scene understanding.
analysis: 4DCodeBench asks AI systems to watch videos of real or synthetic physical events, like fluid flow or fracture, and produce executable graphics/simulation code that reproduces the behavior. The benchmark finds that models good at static 3D reconstruction still struggle badly with dynamics, which is a useful, concrete finding for anyone working on video understanding or program synthesis for physics.
